name: SILLAGE kit — luxury pass (v3)
note: Single source of truth for colours, type, layout, safe zones, scrims and finish. Read by src/*.tsx (composition) and tools/validate.mjs (pre-flight). Palette = the series palette, refined, not replaced.

safe.note: Union of docs/STUDIO.md rule 4 (y<250, y>1440, x>930 under y=860) and the platform brief (230 top, 380 bottom, 160 right). Nothing readable inside.

scrim.note: Every text sits on a scrim. Worst case for the contrast check = pure white behind the scrim.

image.styleSuffix: Cinematic photoreal still, shot on 35mm film, fine film grain, warm golden-hour light, shallow depth of field, soft creamy bokeh, warm rose and amber palette with deep plum shadows, natural textures, luxury fragrance campaign mood. Vertical 9:16 full-frame composition with the subject in the middle third and calm, darker space at the top and bottom for type. No painting, no illustration, no fantasy, no cartoon, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no faces.
image.negative: painting, illustration, watercolour, fantasy, cartoon, anime, CGI, text, letters, logo, watermark, face, portrait
